# Generated by spec-lang build --target cpp from app TodoCpp, @target(cpp), @bin (src/apps/cpp.slg:4). Do not edit: change the spec.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(todo LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)

# Release: whole-program optimisation and one static binary (@why("the board as one static binary")).
include(CheckIPOSupported)
check_ipo_supported(RESULT ipo_ok OUTPUT ipo_message LANGUAGES CXX)
if(ipo_ok)
  set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION_RELEASE ON)
endif()

# The modules' types, fns and rules: pure, no I/O. Nothing here links the store or the cli.
add_library(todo_domain STATIC
  src/model.cpp
  src/render.cpp
  src/board/add.cpp
  src/board/list.cpp
  src/board/done.cpp
  src/board/reopen.cpp
  src/board/rename.cpp
  src/board/remove.cpp
  src/board/clear.cpp
  src/board/apply.cpp
  src/rt/unicode.cpp
  src/rt/text.cpp
)
target_include_directories(todo_domain PUBLIC include)

# @store(file(...)): codec, lock, atomic file.
add_library(todo_store STATIC
  src/store.cpp
  src/rt/json_lexer.cpp
  src/rt/file.cpp
  src/rt/lock.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(todo_store PUBLIC todo_domain)

# The cli vocabulary: parameter table, value parsers, binding.
add_library(todo_cli STATIC src/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(todo_cli PUBLIC todo_domain)

add_executable(todo src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(todo PRIVATE todo_cli todo_store)
target_link_options(todo PRIVATE -static $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-s>)

# Tests: one executable per spec test module, @cases module and law module; a small harness.
enable_testing()
add_library(todo_harness STATIC tests/rt/harness.cpp)
target_include_directories(todo_harness PUBLIC tests tests/rt)

foreach(name model_cases render_cases board scenarios laws)
  add_executable(${name}_test tests/${name}_test.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(${name}_test PRIVATE todo_harness todo_domain)
  add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND ${name}_test)
endforeach()

# The runtime's store failure paths, over a toy app: refusal, unreadable store, unwritable directory, lock release, signals.
add_executable(store_hygiene_test tests/rt/store_hygiene_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(store_hygiene_test PRIVATE todo_harness todo_store)
add_test(NAME store_hygiene COMMAND store_hygiene_test)
